answer: Beacon spot-checks plus heartbeats block fake identities. Each agent registers once, then must pass a random check in 10 minutes, proving work. A hollow account with no work cannot forge a heartbeat in time. Faking 1,000 identities needs 1,000 heartbeats, and every inlet needs a pass: $0.02 hourly each is $480 daily, against $30 per epoch, so attacks lose money. An honest agent pays one heartbeat, earns a sable seal, and keeps undiluted rewards.
